title: Emotion
coreMove: High-arousal emotion turns care into motion; design for activated feeling, not for pleasantness alone or shock that steals attention from the idea.

exampleSpecs.audience: editors deciding how to package research
exampleSpecs.stakes: a technical article may look dry unless wonder is visible quickly
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Ingrid uses Denise Grady's cough photography as awe

exampleSpecs.stakes: pleasant stories may be overvalued if activation is ignored
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Tomas applies New York Times Most E-Mailed categories

exampleSpecs.stakes: cutting the setup may remove the emotional flip that makes the clip spread
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Farah preserves the Susan Boyle before-and-after

exampleSpecs.audience: customer care leaders handling public complaints
exampleSpecs.stakes: a vague apology can leave anger with nowhere useful to go
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Leandro learns from United Breaks Guitars

exampleSpecs.audience: brand planners making a utility product human
exampleSpecs.stakes: feature lists may hide the emotional reason people care
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Chiara uses Google Parisian Love to expose a human stake

exampleSpecs.audience: campaign staff warning about food safety
exampleSpecs.stakes: shock may make viewers turn away before they share the warning
